notes.title: TFN: Conversations with AI and Modifiers
notes.notes: [h1]Hello Gamers![/h1][p]I would like to show you the new starting configuration, now more personalized than ever. One of the advantages of ATEG games is their strong customization of video games. In other games, you might be used to customizing graphics, the interface, audio, and controls, but in ATEG games, you customize the game itself, and we call this 'Options' for game options or 'Modifiers' and even 'GameLab'.[/p][p]Third-party artificial intelligence systems are very robotic, which is why ATEG's conversation systems are used. They are completely natural and also allow for the coordination of actions through conversations. The ATEG conversation system is in constant evolution, and The Fallen Night represents the cornerstone of the evolution of chat with artificial intelligence for video games. I hope you enjoy a good chat with the AI, because in The Fallen Night, that's how you get to know the characters, forge alliances, relationships, and have a good time before a good fight in the bar.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240913/db2adfb9768d425275eebee75287c4662bb6e127.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240913/da3d194b33ac69eef01f9371e5bbc61669e322b8.png"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="CdtMaL3UExk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Note: Don't worry, the conversations will change based on the actions and states of the relationship, and they are also based on the actual actions of the NPCs.
